description.value: Silver Creek Branch is a small rural outpost of the Okanagan Regional Library system, serving the Silver Creek community near Salmon Arm. It offers public computers, Wi-Fi, and a community gathering space, and features a rotating monthly art wall showcasing local artists. The library welcomes clubs and groups and can help organize book clubs, craft circles, or game groups — a quiet local hub in an otherwise rural stretch.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the library's address (921 Salmon River Rd), phone ((250) 832-4719), and Wi-Fi as a listed facility, corroborating the OSM internet_access=wlan tag. The website's facilities list enumerates: Free Parking, AED, Seating, Computers, Wi-Fi, and Book Drop — no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities. This is a very small rural branch with minimal documented cyclist-relevant infrastructure.
concerns: Library has very limited open days — may not be reliably accessible to passing cyclists.
Washrooms not listed among facilities on the website despite being a common library amenity; unable to confirm or deny.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a very small rural library branch with only Wi-Fi confirmed as a cyclist-relevant amenity; no bike parking, washrooms, or water refill are documented. Its value to touring cyclists is limited and ambiguous without further on-site verification.
enrichment_extras.notes: Free parking in front of the library is confirmed by website. The library offers space for clubs/groups to meet, including some evening times.

wow_evidence: Small rural branch with art wall; ordinary library band.
blurb: Silver Creek's small library branch near Salmon Arm.
